tasks.objective: 电池热管理与功率请求跟踪. 在高环境温度和持续功率请求下，控制器应通过冷却与功率降额将电池核心温度限制在安全范围内，同时保持SOC与电压合理。. Scenario time window 0s to 1200s; inputs: ambient_temp_C, driver_power_request_W_profil

constraint_set.source_text: 电池热管理与功率请求跟踪. 在高环境温度和持续功率请求下，控制器应通过冷却与功率降额将电池核心温度限制在安全范围内，同时保持SOC与电压合理。. Scenario time window 0s to 1200s; inputs: ambient_temp_C, driver_power_request_W_profile; initial conditions: T_core_C, T_surface_C, coolant_temp_C, soc. Acceptance criteria: max(T_core_C) <= 55.0; min(soc) >= 0.2; within_range(voltage_V) in [280.0, 420.0]; within_range(pump_cmd) in [0.0, 1.0]; within_range(fan_cmd) in [0.0, 1.0]. Signals of interest: driver_power_request_W, current_A, voltage_V, soc, T_core_C, T_surface_C, coolant_in_temp_C, coolant_flow_kgps, pump_cmd, fan_cmd Verification should conclude pass only when the co-simulation runs to completion and satisfies every acceptance criterion on the monitored signals.

selected_fmus.name: CoolingLoop
selected_fmus.description: Simplified liquid cooling loop with pump + radiator + fan. Produces coolant inlet temperature to battery and flow rate based on commands and heat load. Includes nonlinear flow and UA characteristics plus actuator dynamics.

ports.name: heat_load_W
ports.description: Heat that must be removed from battery (positive adds heat to coolant).

ports.name: coolant_flow_kgps
ports.description: Coolant mass flow rate through battery cold-plate.

ports.name: coolant_mass_kg
ports.description: Effective coolant thermal mass in the loop.

ports.name: flow_max_kgps
ports.description: Maximum coolant mass flow at pump_cmd=1.

ports.name: pump_tau_s
ports.description: First-order lag time constant for pump speed/flow response.

ports.name: pump_power_max_W
ports.description: Pump electric power at full command.

ports.name: T_min_C
ports.description: Lower bound for coolant temperature to avoid numerical issues.

ports.name: T_max_C
ports.description: Upper bound for coolant temperature to avoid numerical issues.
